title: Picking a different status changes nothing until Save
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919), with 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Active part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PICK-01) is stocked at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. On the Active tab, type {Part-A} in the search.
  2. Click the {Part-A} row.
  3. Click the Inactive option.
  4. Click Cancel.
  5. Type {Part-A} in the search on the Active tab again.
  6. Click the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: Inactive is selected and nothing else happens: no window opens.
  • Step 4: the window closes without asking anything.
  • Step 5: {Part-A} is still on the Active tab.
  • Step 6: Part Status shows Active.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S13-R21, §4 Key Decisions, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 3.2 (Inactive picked), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R21: “Picking a different status changes nothing until Save. When Save is pressed with a different status picked, the confirmation of Story 10 opens first.”
  • PRD §4 Key Decisions (status in the dialog): “The part dialog sets the status, and Save applies it. Part Status is a choice in the form. Picking Active or Inactive changes nothing until Save, and Save asks for confirmation first, the same confirmation the list uses.”
